form.title: Send us a message
form.requiredNote: Fields marked <star>*</star><sr>as required</sr> are required. Your message goes to the Reduium support team.
form.errorSummary_one: Please fix the highlighted field below.
form.errorSummary_other: Please fix the {{count, number}} highlighted fields below.

fields.name: Your name *
fields.emailHint: We'll use this to reply to you.
fields.trackingNumberHint: If your message is about a shipment.
fields.subject: Subject *

form.privacy: We use these details only to answer your message. They are stored securely and are visible only to Reduium staff. We don't send confirmation emails yet: after sending, you'll see a reference to keep.

errors.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid phone number, e.g. +44 20 7946 0000.
errors.trackingNumberInvalid: That does not look like a Reduium tracking number. It should look like RDM-XXXX-XXXX-X.
errors.topicRequired: Choose what your message is about.
errors.rejected: Your message could not be sent. Please try again, or contact us by email or phone.
errors.rateLimited: We have received several messages from you recently. Please wait a while before sending another, or contact us by email or phone.
errors.unavailable: The contact form is temporarily unavailable. Please contact us by email or phone.
errors.network: We couldn't send your message. Check your connection and try again, or contact us by email or phone.

receipt.title: Message received
receipt.body: Thank you. Your message has been saved for the Reduium support team. Your reference is:
receipt.note: Please quote this reference if you contact us again. We don't send a confirmation email, so keep a note of it. We'll reply to the email address you gave.
